verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developers page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow,' alongside a Zapier integration, so a first-party API is claimed. The evidence only shows a marketing mention, though: probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec, no llms.txt and no markdown docs. The extent of public API documentation is therefore unproven. Missing for 10: published API reference/endpoint documentation, machine-readable spec (OpenAPI), authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage.
